61055-the-valley-of-the-masters.title: The Valley Of The Masters
61055-the-valley-of-the-masters.creator: Unknown
61055-the-valley-of-the-masters.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. down they awaited a vacant Mastership--a plot of orchard and the house that went with it--and moved in. They took over the responsibilities of the place and bred or adopted the three children necessary to hold it. They remained there until they became Elders. Then they moved into Town, where they worked in the factories, idled and gossiped until death overtook them.

arxiv-2004-07796.title: Detecting many-body Bell non-locality by solving Ising models
arxiv-2004-07796.creator: Irénée Frérot, Tommaso Roscilde
arxiv-2004-07796.description: Abstract Bell non-locality represents the ultimate consequence of quantum entanglement, fundamentally undermining the classical tenet that spatially-separated degrees of freedom possess objective attributes independently of the act of their measurement. Despite its importance, probing Bell non-locality in many-body systems is considered to be a formidable challenge, with a computational cost scaling exponentially with system size.

arxiv-2204-08056.title: Homogeneous algebraic varieties and transitivity degree Thanks: This research was supported by the Ministry of Science and Higher Education of the Russian Federation, agreement 075-15-2019-1620 date 08/11/2019 and 075-15-2022-289 date 06/04/2022
arxiv-2204-08056.creator: Ivan Arzhantsev, Kirill Shakhmatov, Yulia Zaitseva
arxiv-2204-08056.description: Abstract . Let X X be an algebraic variety such that the group Aut ⁡ ( X ) \Aut(X) acts on X X transitively. We define the transitivity degree of X X as a maximal number m m such that the action of Aut ⁡ ( X ) \Aut(X) on X X is m m -transitive.

arxiv-2210-00828.title: Mastering Spatial Graph Prediction of Road Networks
arxiv-2210-00828.creator: Sotiris Anagnostidis, Aurelien Lucchi, Thomas Hofmann
arxiv-2210-00828.description: Abstract Accurately predicting road networks from satellite images requires a global understanding of the network topology. We propose to capture such high-level information by introducing a graph-based framework that simulates the addition of sequences of graph edges using a reinforcement learning (RL) approach.

arxiv-2305-04005.title: TMD parton showers for associated γ \gamma + + jet production in electron-proton collisions at high energies
arxiv-2305-04005.creator: A.V. Lipatov, M.A. Malyshev
arxiv-2305-04005.description: Abstract 1 Skobeltsyn Institute of Nuclear Physics, Lomonosov Moscow State University, 119991, Moscow, Russia 2 Joint Institute for Nuclear Research, 141980, Dubna, Moscow region, Russia Abstract An earlier developed k_{T} -factorization framework to calculate the associated prompt photon and hadronic jets production cross sections at high energies is extended now to the electron-proton deep inelastic scattering.

arxiv-2406-16468.title: The Hidden Pitfalls of the Cosine Similarity Loss
arxiv-2406-16468.creator: Andrew Draganov, Sharvaree Vadgama, Erik J. Bekkers
arxiv-2406-16468.description: Abstract We show that the gradient of the cosine similarity between two points goes to zero in two under-explored settings: (1) if a point has large magnitude or (2) if the points are on opposite ends of the latent space. Counterintuitively, we prove that optimizing the cosine similarity between points forces them to grow in magnitude.

arxiv-2408-11777.title: CI/CD Efforts for Validation, Verification and Benchmarking OpenMP Implementations
arxiv-2408-11777.creator: Aaron Jarmusch, Felipe Cabarcas, Swaroop Pophale, Andrew Kallai, Johannes Doerfert, Luke Peyralans, Seyong Lee, Joel Denny, Sunita Chandrasekaran
arxiv-2408-11777.description: Abstract Software developers must adapt to keep up with the changing capabilities of platforms so that they can utilize the power of High-Performance Computers (HPC), including exascale systems. OpenMP, a directive-based parallel programming model, allows developers to include directives to existing C, C++, or Fortran code to allow node level parallelism without compromising performance.

arxiv-2502-05142.title: Chest X-ray Foundation Model with Global and Local Representations Integration Thanks: Z. Yang, X. Xu, G. Wang, and P. Yan* are with the Department of Biomedical Engineering and Center for Biotechnology and Interdisciplinary Studies, Rensselaer Polytechnic Institute, Troy, NY, USA. Thanks: J. Zhang
arxiv-2502-05142.creator: Zefan Yang, Xuanang Xu, Jiajin Zhang, Ge Wang
arxiv-2502-05142.description: Abstract Chest X-ray (CXR) is the most frequently ordered imaging test, supporting diverse clinical tasks from thoracic disease detection to postoperative monitoring. However, task-specific classification models are limited in scope, require costly labeled data, and lack generalizability to out-of-distribution datasets.

arxiv-2511-20770.title: Text-Guided Semantic Image Encoder
arxiv-2511-20770.creator: Raghuveer Thirukovalluru, Xiaochuang Han, Bhuwan Dhingra, Emily Dinan, Maha Elbayad
arxiv-2511-20770.description: Abstract Image encoders, a fundamental component of vision–language models (VLMs), are typically pretrained independently before being aligned with a language model. This standard paradigm results in encoders that process images agnostically, without regard to the specific downstream task or text query.

arxiv-2601-16902.title: Representations of Noncommutative Cubes and Prisms
arxiv-2601-16902.creator: Douglas Farenick, Roghayeh Maleki, Sofia Medina Varela, and Sushil Singla
arxiv-2601-16902.description: Abstract . Representations of the operator system determined by the canonical generators of the free product of two cyclic groups of order 2 2 and k k , or d d cyclic groups of order 2 2 , are studied for the purpose of shedding light on the noncommutative geometry of noncommutative d d -cubes and k k -prisms.

europmc-pmc490026.creator: Glynn EF, Megee PC, Yu HG, Mistrot C, Unal E, Koshland DE, DeRisi JL, Gerton JL.
europmc-pmc490026.description: In eukaryotic cells, cohesin holds sister chromatids together until they separate into daughter cells during mitosis. We have used chromatin immunoprecipitation coupled with microarray analysis (ChIP chip) to produce a genome-wide description of cohesin binding to meiotic and...

plos-pbio-0020120.creator: Jessica R Ward, Kevin D Lafferty
plos-pbio-0020120.description: PLOS ONE research article. Disease outbreaks alter the structure and function of marine ecosystems, directly affecting vertebrates (mammals, turtles, fish), invertebrates (corals, crustaceans, echinoderms), and plants (seagrasses). Previous studies suggest a recent increase in marine disease. However, lack

pmc-10669923.title: Ruthenium brachytherapy for iris melanoma
pmc-10669923.creator: Emilia Zwolin´ska, Lidia Główka, Adam Chicheł, Iwona Rospond-Kubiak
pmc-10669923.description: PurposeThe study aimed to review the long-term outcomes of ruthenium brachytherapy for iris and iridociliary melanoma.Material And MethodsMedical records of patients who underwent ruthenium plaque treatment for iris and iridociliary melanoma at the Department of Ophthalmology, Poznań University of Medical Sciences, between 1999 and 2021 were retrospectively reviewed.

pmc-10746444.title: Game of strokes: Optimal & conversion strategy algorithms with simulations & application
pmc-10746444.creator: David Iheke Okorie, Joel Miworse Gnatchiglo
pmc-10746444.description: Strategic decision-making for sequential move games requires rationality and continuity of rationality to guarantee maximum payoffs at all nodes/stages/levels. Rationality and continuity of rationality in a player's behaviour are not often observed and/or maintained thus, leading to less optimal outcomes.

pmc-11310316.title: Palladium-catalyzed cascade of aza-Wacker and Povarov reactions of aryl amines and 1,6-dienes for hexahydro-cyclopenta[b]quinoline framework
pmc-11310316.creator: Jiahao Wu, Xiangwen Tan, Wanqing Wu, Huanfeng Jiang
pmc-11310316.description: Palladium catalyzed tandem reaction represents a one-pot synthetic approach to efficiently synthesize complex functionalized molecules while reducing synthetic steps, aligning with the principles of green chemistry. However, achieving a direct cascade of the aza-Wacker and Povarov reactions in one-pot synthesis presents a challenge due to substrate compatibility issues between the two reactions.

pmc-11352220.title: Cyborg Children: A Systematic Literature Review on the Experience of Children Using Extended Reality
pmc-11352220.creator: Marina Everri, Maxi Heitmayer, Jun Kohyama
pmc-11352220.description: This literature review presents a comprehensive and systematic account of research on the experiences of children with extended reality (XR), including VR, AR, and other types of immersive technologies that enhance and augment children’s activities. The search on Scopus and Web of Science produced 531 outputs.

pmc-11615613.title: Clustering of TP53 variants into functional classes correlates with cancer risk and identifies different phenotypes of Li-Fraumeni syndrome
pmc-11615613.creator: Emilie Montellier, Nathanaël Lemonnier, Judith Penkert, Claire Freycon, Sandrine Blanchet, Amina Amadou, Florent Chuffart, Nicholas W. Fischer, Maria-Isabel Achatz, Arnold J. Levine, Catherine Goudie, David Malkin, Gaëlle Bougeard, Christian P. Kratz, Pierre Hainaut
pmc-11615613.description: SummaryLi-Fraumeni syndrome (LFS) is a heterogeneous predisposition to an individually variable spectrum of cancers caused by pathogenic TP53 germline variants. We used a clustering method to assign TP53 missense variants to classes based on their functional activities in experimental assays assessing biological p53 functions.

pmc-11664125.title: Hydroxyurea therapy for neurological and cognitive protection in pediatric sickle cell anemia in Uganda (BRAIN SAFE II): Protocol for a single-arm open label trial☆
pmc-11664125.creator: Vincent Mboizi, Catherine Nabaggala, Deogratias Munube, John M Ssenkusu, Phillip Kasirye, Samson Kamya, Michael G Kawooya, Amelia Boehme, Frank Minja, Ezekiel Mupere, Robert Opoka, Caterina Rosano, Richard Idro, Nancy S Green
pmc-11664125.description: BackgroundChildren with sickle cell anemia (SCA) in Sub-Saharan Africa are at high risk of sickle cerebrovascular injury (SCVI). Hydroxyurea, a commonly used disease-modifying therapy, may reduce SCVI resulting in potential impact on reducing stroke and cognitive dysfunction. We aim to test the impact of daily hydroxyurea therapy on these outcomes in Ugandan children with SCA.

pmc-12711990.title: Unlocking the hidden pathways: river channel delineation and reservoir characterization in Shurijeh Formation, Kopeh Dagh Basin
pmc-12711990.creator: Vali Mehdipour, Zahra Sadeghtabaghi
pmc-12711990.description: The Shurijeh Formation is the primary gas reservoir within the Kopeh Dagh-Amu Darya Basin, deposited in a fluvial and deltaic environment. Due to significant lateral variability associated with floodplain and river channel settings, detailed characterization of river channels is essential for optimal reservoir management.

pmc-12961421.title: T‐bet Fate Mapping Reveals Gestational Stage‐Specific Transcriptional Adaptation of Decidual NK Cells
pmc-12961421.creator: Mona A Mohamed, Yan Li, Andrea K Wegrzynowicz, Payton N Lindner, Jessica Vazquez, Gladys E Lopez, Aleksandar K Stanic
pmc-12961421.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). ProblemNatural killer (NK) cells are critical regulators of immune balance at the maternal–fetal interface. T‐bet (Tbx21) is a key transcription factor shaping NK cell effector functions, yet its role in decidual NK (dNK) cell adaptation across gestation remains unclear.Method of StudyWe used a T‐bet fate‐mapping mouse model (Rosa26RFP × Tbx21Cre) to track developmental and functional reprogramming of NK cells in the uterus, decidua, and placenta throughout pregnancy.

pmc-13290281.title: Sorbent Intervention to Reduce Per- and Polyfluoroalkyl Substances (PFAS) in Maternal Reproductive Tissues and Transgenerational Translocation in Sprague-Dawley Rats
pmc-13290281.creator: Johnson O. Oladele, Kelly J. Rivenbark, Damilare A. Adekomi, Timothy D. Phillips, Meichen Wang
pmc-13290281.description: Per- and polyfluoroalkyl substances (PFAS) are persistent environmental contaminants, posing significant health risks, particularly during critical exposure windows such as gestation and lactation. In this study, following prenatal and postnatal exposure to 0.95 mg PFAS/kg-bw/day in F0 Sprague-Dawley rats, their toxicity to maternal reproductive tissues and translocation to offspring were measured.

pmc-13433785.title: A multi-domain graph-integrated neural framework for robust acoustic anomaly detection under adverse environmental conditions
pmc-13433785.creator: Ayan Sar, Sumit Aich, Pranav Singh Puri, Sampurna Roy, Tanupriya Choudhury, Lubna Abdelkareim Gabralla, Minakshi, Bhupesh Kumar Dewangan
pmc-13433785.description: Acoustic event understanding and anomaly detection play a critical role in security monitoring, defence applications, and urban safety, yet current approaches struggle to generalise across noisy environments, rare event categories, and varying distances. To address these limitations, we propose a multi-domain, graph-integrated neural framework that unifies spectral, temporal, and phase representations for robust acoustic modeling.

pmc-13436063.title: Association of the triglyceride-glucose index with the risk of sarcopenia: a meta-analysis with clinical implications
pmc-13436063.creator: Jing Wei, Li Yuan, Linzhu Xiong, Lin Ruan, Rui Lin, Hongmei Jiang
pmc-13436063.description: PurposeSarcopenia is associated with adverse clinical outcomes in older adults, yet simple and widely available biomarkers for early risk identification remain limited. This study aimed to determine the relationship between the triglyceride-glucose (TyG) index and the risk of sarcopenia.MethodsPubMed, Web of Science and CNKI databases were searched up to October 27, 2025.

pmc-13619170.title: Molybdenum doping enhances backbonding at neighboring iron centers in iron-sulfur clusters

pmc-13700359.title: A multicenter randomized controlled study to evaluate the efficacy of an artificial intelligence–based electrocardiography for the detection of atrial fibrillation in patients with suspected symptoms (DEEP-AF)
pmc-13700359.creator: Ki-Jeung Lee, Chang-Ok Seo, Joo Hee Jeong, Yeji Kim, Kyung-Yeon Lee, Hanjin Park, Hyoung Seok Lee, Ji-Hun Jang, Dae-Young Kim, Seong Huan Choi, Daehoon Kim, Do Young Kim, Je-Wook Park, Hee Tae Yu, Pil-Sung Yang, Kwang-No Lee, Yun Gi Kim, Seung-Young Roh, You-Mi Hwang, Chan-Hee Lee, Yong-Soo Baek, Do
pmc-13700359.description: BackgroundAtrial fibrillation (AF) is frequently paroxysmal and asymptomatic, leading to delayed diagnosis and missed opportunities for stroke prevention. Artificial intelligence (AI) applied to 12-lead electrocardiograms (ECGs) obtained during sinus rhythm may enable risk stratification and more efficient allocation of rhythm-monitoring resources.
